question: In May 2022, President Ram Nath Kovind appointed ______ as the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinai Kumar Saxena.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vinai Kumar Saxena was appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi in May 2022 by President Ram Nath Kovind.**
 
• Vinai Kumar Saxena is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1983 batch from the Assam-Meghalaya cadre.
 
• He has served as the Chairman** **of the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) and the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) in the past.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manoj Sinha is a politician from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).**

 
 
• He is currently serving as the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir. 
 
 
 
• **Admiral D K Joshi is a retired Indian Navy officer.**
 
 
• He served as the Chief of Naval Staff from 2012 to 2014.
 
 
 
• **Dr Tamilisai Soundararajan is a politician from the BJP.**
 
 
• She served as the second Governor of Telangana, and also served as Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry from 18 February 2021 to 18 March 2024.
